scenarios.name: play-land-from-graveyard
scenarios.why: Walk-In Closet lets its controller play lands from their graveyard, so the Forest in the graveyard may be played as the turn's land drop and enters untapped.

scenarios.name: no-permission-no-graveyard-land-play
scenarios.why: A land card in the graveyard is not playable without a permission-granting effect.
